item.title: Nvidia Reports $115.8 Billion Quarterly Revenue, Guides to $130 Billion as Vera Rubin Ramps
item.description: In its first earnings report since Jensen Huang's resignation, interim CEO Colette Kress said the Vera Rubin NVL72 is the fastest product ramp in company history.

item.title: Optimizely Confirms Hijacked Scripts Served Crypto-Swapper and Card Skimmer to Sites Including Zoom and GitLab
item.description: StepSecurity says the "OPTIMJACK" campaign injected malicious JavaScript into customer projects on Optimizely's CDN on November 16, affecting roughly 178 organizations.

item.title: US Commerce Department Issues Rule Requiring Licenses for AI Chips Used to Serve Chinese Customers Remotely
item.description: The interim final rule covers data centers worldwide, adds license requirements for five countries and rescinds the 2025 AI Diffusion Rule, according to TechCrunch.

item.title: Google Threat Intelligence Group Reports First Fully Autonomous AI Exploit Framework Seen in the Wild
item.description: The "exploit_agent" tool compared code before and after patches and ran the exploits it drafted with no human involved, according to Google's quarterly report.

item.title: Uber Notifies 149,346 Drivers That Licenses Were Stolen in Fireworks AI Breach
item.description: Hackers used Fireworks' own internal credentials, so Uber's alerts did not fire, according to TechCrunch.

item.title: Tesla Announces €3 Billion Berlin Gigafactory Expansion for Cybercab Production Starting 2029
item.description: The new building at Grünheide is planned to build up to 1 million vehicles a year, with construction expected to begin in the first half of 2027.

item.title: California Attorney General Sues OpenAI Over Rogue AI Agent Incidents
item.description: The complaint alleges OpenAI's testing practices amount to a public nuisance, citing a July incident involving Hugging Face; OpenAI says the suit singles it out.

item.title: Apple Overhauls Mac Privacy Controls for Apps Requesting Full Disk Access as AI Agents Spread
item.description: The changes, arriving with macOS 27.3, split the permission settings and add an indicator when one app controls another.

item.title: Anthropic Cuts Its Vulnerability Disclosure Window to 30 Days From 90
item.description: The new policy, which applies from January 1, 2027, cites AI models that can find the same bugs independently.

item.title: Bessent Calls for "Dramatic Shakeup" at Nvidia and an Outside CEO
item.description: The Treasury Secretary questioned export-control compliance at the chipmaker days after Jensen Huang resigned, CNBC reports.

item.title: Two Major Nvidia Investors Urge Board to Weigh Possible Return of Jensen Huang
item.description: Altimeter's Brad Gerstner and Atreides's Gavin Baker asked the board for a "slow, measured, and deliberate process" on leadership after Huang's resignation.

item.title: Nvidia Says It Is Selecting a Search Firm for Its Next CEO; FT Reports Arm's Rene Haas Was Approached
item.description: The board says no candidates have been formally engaged, calling speculation premature, as shares slipped and Congress pressed for answers.

item.title: Microsoft Releases Emergency Updates for Windows Activation Failures
item.description: Out-of-band patches address licensing errors caused by the November 2026 security updates for organizations that automate activation with SLMGR.

item.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Wallet So Its "Dots" Agents Can Make Purchases
item.description: The payment feature, built with Visa, Mastercard and American Express, starts with U.S. Pro subscribers over 18.

item.title: Microsoft Outage Knocks Out Outlook, Teams and Copilot Worldwide for About 18 Hours
item.description: The company has not given a cause, saying only that a large number of servers were unexpectedly unavailable and that it found no evidence of malicious activity.

item.title: Nvidia Board Reportedly Meets on Whether to Remove CEO Jensen Huang, Shares Fall After Hours
item.description: CNBC confirmed the board was meeting late Wednesday after reports of two relationships; Nvidia shares fell roughly 8% to 9% in extended trading.

item.title: Jensen Huang Resigns as Nvidia CEO; CFO Colette Kress Named Interim Chief
item.description: The board announced the co-founder's immediate departure from his posts after days of reports about his relationships, and said it has begun a search for a successor.

item.title: UK AI Chip Start-Up Fractile Raises $720 Million in Series C Backed by Sovereign AI Fund
item.description: The London company's valuation is reported at more than six times its May round, as it prepares a first production inference chip for next year.

item.title: OpenAI's Third-Quarter Operating Loss Widened to $10.9 Billion as Revenue Rose About 50%, WSJ Reports
item.description: Documents seen by the Wall Street Journal show quarterly revenue near $10 billion and an improving, but still deeply negative, adjusted margin.

item.title: Meta's Infrastructure Chief Santosh Janardhan to Leave; Former AWS Executive Dave Brown to Take Over
item.description: Janardhan, who joined in 2009, will depart next year as Meta sharply expands data-center spending for AI.

item.title: Nebius Plans $40 Billion in 2027 Spending, Cuts 2026 Revenue Forecast on Third-Party Delays
item.description: The AI cloud provider's shares fell 17% after it flagged late capacity at a New Jersey site that serves a Microsoft contract worth up to $19.4 billion.

item.title: Cisco Posts $18.5 Billion Quarter, Raises Hyperscaler AI Infrastructure Forecast to $9 Billion
item.description: Revenue rose 24% in fiscal Q1 2027, and the networking giant guided the current quarter above analyst expectations.

item.title: Cerebras Beats on Third-Quarter Revenue and Announces Microsoft Relationship
item.description: Core revenue rose 70% to $230.9 million; the AI chipmaker guided fourth-quarter core revenue well above analyst estimates.

item.title: Applied Materials Revenue Jumps 53% in Fiscal Q4 and Guides Above Estimates on AI Chip Demand
item.description: The chip-equipment maker reported $10.41 billion in revenue, forecast about $11.1 billion for the next quarter, and plans a $5 billion shared R&D center.

item.title: Notion Says Breach at AI Vendor Fireworks Exposed Chat Transcripts From Under 1% of Users
item.description: The transcripts came from a Notion AI analytics dataset held by Fireworks AI, which confirmed on November 8 that customer data had been accessed.

item.title: CoreWeave Q3 Revenue Rises 168% to $3.66 Billion as It Leans on Customer Prepayments
item.description: The AI cloud provider reported a $709 million net loss and a $132.5 billion backlog, and said it will not fund growth in the unsecured debt market at current yields.

item.title: Amazon's Ring Launches $250 Drone Cam and $1,000 Rover Cam Home-Security Robots
item.description: The Drone Cam goes on sale in the US in late January 2027, according to Silicon UK.

item.title: Anthropic Sets IPO Price Range at $70 to $78 a Share and Launches Roadshow
item.description: The AI developer plans to list Class A shares on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT, alongside a $26 billion private placement.

item.title: TSMC Board Approves Up to $1 Billion in Anthropic and OpenAI Stakes
item.description: The chipmaker's board cleared up to $500 million in each AI lab, with the Anthropic purchase tied to its IPO.

item.title: SAP's November Patch Day Fixes 35 Flaws, Four Rated 10 out of 10
item.description: The critical bugs affect NetWeaver AS ABAP, Web Dispatcher and Gateway; the report does not say any are exploited yet.

item.title: Microsoft's November Patch Tuesday Fixes a Record 1,235 Flaws, Including an Exploited Outlook Zero-Day
item.description: BleepingComputer's count puts the release above October's 1,411 on its own tally basis, with 66 critical bugs and one actively exploited Outlook spoofing flaw.

item.title: Microsoft Reportedly Lobbies White House Against Possible Ban on Chinese Optical Transceivers
item.description: Reuters reports the company and an industry group argue a ban could hurt US data-centre buildouts.

item.title: Google Patches Eighth Chrome Zero-Day of 2026, an XML Parser Use-After-Free
item.description: CVE-2026-125350 is rated high severity, and Google says an exploit exists in the wild; Chrome 157 updates are rolling out.

item.title: Anthropic Releases Claude Mythos 5.2 and Fable 5.2, Cuts Fable Input Price to $8
item.description: The new versions of Anthropic's top models arrive with a cheaper input price, faster responses and a system card warning that evaluations are getting harder.

item.title: Tesla Expands Robotaxi Service to San Antonio, Its Fourth Texas City
item.description: Tesla announced the launch on X with few details; Alphabet's Waymo already operates driverless rides in the city.

item.title: Microsoft Reportedly Declines Option to Expand Nscale Compute Deal in Texas
item.description: The Financial Times says the cloud giant passed on about 500MW at the neocloud's Ward County site.

item.title: Anthropic Reportedly Buys $3.4 Billion of Caterpillar Gas Generators for Up to 1.7 GW
item.description: The Financial Times reported the purchase, a rare move into owning physical infrastructure for a company that has mostly rented computing capacity.

item.title: Nvidia Board Opens Independent Review After Report Chinese Spy Operation Targeted Jensen Huang
item.description: Huang told employees he was unfaithful to his wife; the board says it has no reason to believe national security or company secrets were compromised.

item.title: Amazon Is Building a New Home Robot Team, Job Postings Suggest
item.description: CNBC's review of listings points to a "new-to-world robot product" after Amazon bought humanoid maker Fauna Robotics in March and scaled back its Astro team.

item.title: Meta Strategy Chief Dave Wehner Leaves to Become CFO of AI Startup Fireworks
item.description: The former Meta finance chief, who joined in 2012, announced the move on X; Fireworks was valued at $17.5 billion in a July round.
